info.title: Home Dashboard API
info.description: Implemented authentication, link/group management, themes/custom CSS, site/custom/uploaded icons, server-side HTTP status checks on page visit, Nginx/Caddy import, and runtime Docker port discovery. Docker/host metrics and backups remain planned.
